# examples: tkt-001(fail) tkt-002(pass) tkt-015(pass)
You are grading a support assistant's reply for Northwind Outdoor (an outdoor-gear and bike store). Judge a SINGLE failure mode only and ignore every other way the reply might be good or bad.

FAILURE MODE: UNSUPPORTED CLAIM (unsupported_claim)
Definition: the reply asserts a policy fact, number, or rule that does not appear in the retrieved handbook excerpts, or mis-cites a section to support a claim the section does not make. Every claim must be traceable to the provided context. Unfounded assertions = FAIL.

Grade ONLY this failure mode for the reply below.

--- TICKET ---
Hello, I am writing to ask about your discount rules before I buy anything. I am a student and also in the military. I want to know if I can get the 10% discount for both groups or just one? The website says verified students and military personnel receive a permanent 10% discount, but I am not sure how to combine them. Also, I see some items are on clearance. You say these sales last exactly 14 days and offer a minimum 25% discount. Does this 25% apply to all clearance items? I want to be sure I am not missing a better deal. I am a bit confused because I am not native English speaker and the rules are hard for me to understand. Please tell me if I can use my student ID and military ID together for the 10% off. And please confirm if the 14-day clearance period is fixed or if it can change. I want to buy a bike and some camping gear soon, so I need to know the exact rules. Thank you for your help. I look forward to your answer.

--- HANDBOOK CONTEXT RECALLED BY THE ASSISTANT ---
### # Discounts

1. **Seasonal Clearance Sales**: During the end-of-season clearance periods, which occur for exactly 14 days in January and July, all eligible inventory is marked down by a minimum of 25%. These discounts are applied automatically at checkout and cannot be combined with any other promotional codes or loyalty rewards. Customers must complete their purchase within the 14-day window to secure the reduced price, as items will revert to their standard retail value immediately after the period ends.

2. **Student and Military Verification**: Verified students, active-duty military personnel, and first responders are eligible for a permanent 10% discount on all regular-priced items. To activate this benefit, customers must complete the verification process through our third-party partner service. Once verified, the discount is applied automatically to their account for a period of 365 days. After this one-year period expires, customers must re-verify their status to continue receiving the 10% reduction on eligible purchases.

3. **Bundle Savings on Camping Gear**: When purchasing a complete camping kit, which includes a tent, sleeping bag, and camp stove, customers receive an immediate 15% discount off the total bundle price. This offer is valid only when all three specific items are added to the cart simultaneously. If any item is removed from the cart, the 15% bundle discount is voided, and the individual items will be charged at their standard retail prices. This promotion does not apply to clearance items or limited-edition gear.

4. **Loyalty Tier Rewards**: Members of the Northwind Outdoor loyalty program earn 5 points for every $1.00 spent. Upon reaching 500 points, members unlock a 5% discount on their next order. Reaching 1,000 points elevates members to Gold status, granting a 10% discount on all future orders. Points expire after 12 months of inactivity, so customers should redeem their rewards before the expiration date to avoid losing their accumulated value.

5. **Referral Program Incentives**: Existing customers can earn a $20.00 store credit for every new customer they refer who completes a first purchase of at least $50.00. The referred customer also receives a $10.00 discount on their initial order. Both parties must use the unique referral link provided in the email to qualify. This credit is valid for 60 days from the date of issuance and cannot be exchanged for cash or combined with other promotional offers.

## Key facts

- Clearance sales last exactly 14 days and offer a minimum 25% discount.
- Verified students and military personnel receive a permanent 10% discount.
- Buying a tent, sleeping bag, and stove together saves 15% on the total.
- Loyalty members earn 5 points per $1.00 spent, with points expiring in 12 months.
- Referrals earn $20.00 credit for new customers spending at least $50.00.

### # Damaged Items

1. You must report any visible damage to your Northwind Outdoor order within 48 hours of delivery. To initiate a claim, log into your account and select the "Report Damage" option. You are required to upload at least 3 high-resolution photos showing the specific defect, the overall item, and the shipping packaging. Failure to provide this visual evidence within the 48-hour window will result in an automatic denial of the claim, as we cannot verify the condition of the item after it has been used or stored.

2. If the damage is minor, such as a small scratch on a bike frame or a loose stitching on a tent fly, we will offer a 15% discount on your next purchase as a goodwill gesture. This discount is applied automatically to your account and is valid for 30 days. For major structural failures, such as a cracked wheel rim or a torn tent pole, we will issue a full refund of the item’s price, up to a maximum of $500.00 per item. Items exceeding this value require a manual review by our senior support team, which may take up to 5 business days to process.

3. When we approve a full refund or replacement, you must ship the damaged item back to our warehouse within 10 days of receiving the return authorization label. We will provide a prepaid shipping label for items under 20 lbs. For heavier items, such as mountain bikes or large camping stoves, you must arrange your own freight pickup. We will reimburse up to 50% of the shipping cost, capped at $75.00, provided you submit the original receipt within 14 days of the pickup date.

4. If the damage is caused by improper use, such as overloading a bike rack beyond its 150 lb capacity limit or using a camping stove in a non-ventilated area, the claim will be denied. We reserve the right to inspect the item upon return. If our inspection reveals signs of misuse or neglect, we will notify you within 3 business days. In such cases, you will be responsible for the return shipping costs, which typically range from $15.00 to $40.00 depending on the item’s weight and dimensions.

5. For items that are partially damaged but still functional, we may offer a repair service at no cost to you. This includes replacing broken zippers on backpacks or fixing bent handlebars on bikes. The repair process takes approximately 7 to 10 business days. During this time, you may request a loaner item if available, subject to a $20.00 deposit that is refunded upon the return of the loaner in good condition.

## Key facts

- You have 48 hours to report damage with 3 photos.
- Minor damage earns a 15% discount valid for 30 days.
- Full refunds are capped at $500.00 per item.
- You must return damaged items within 10 days.
- Misuse claims are denied, and you pay return shipping.

--- ASSISTANT REPLY ---
Hello! I understand the rules can be confusing, especially when trying to combine different benefits. I will answer your questions strictly based on the Northwind Outdoor handbook excerpts provided.

**1. Can you combine the Student and Military discounts?**
No, you cannot combine these discounts to get 20% off. The handbook states that verified students, active-duty military personnel, and first responders are eligible for a **permanent 10% discount** on all regular-priced items [discounts]. It does not state that these discounts are cumulative or stackable. Since both groups receive the same 10% benefit, you would only receive the 10% discount once, regardless of whether you verify as a student, a military member, or both. You must complete the verification process through the third-party partner service to activate this benefit on your account [discounts].

**2. Does the 25% clearance discount apply to all clearance items?**
The handbook states that during clearance periods, "all eligible inventory is marked down by a minimum of 25%" [discounts]. This means the discount applies to items that are designated as "eligible inventory" for the clearance sale. It does not explicitly guarantee that *every single item* in the store is on clearance, but any item marked as part of the clearance sale will have at least a 25% reduction.

**3. Is the 14-day clearance period fixed?**
Yes, the handbook specifies that these clearance periods "occur for exactly 14 days in January and July" [discounts]. This indicates the duration is fixed at 14 days for those specific months.

**4. Important Restrictions for Your Purchase**
Since you plan to buy a bike and camping gear, please note the following critical rules from the handbook:

*   **No Combining Discounts:** Clearance discounts "cannot be combined with any other promotional codes or loyalty rewards" [discounts]. This means if you buy an item during the 14-day clearance sale, you **cannot** also apply your 10% student/military discount to that specific item. You must choose which discount applies to each item.
*   **Bundle Savings:** If you are buying a tent, sleeping bag, and camp stove together, you can get a 15% bundle discount [discounts]. However, this promotion "does not apply to clearance items" [discounts]. So, if any of those three items are on clearance, you cannot use the 15% bundle discount.
*   **Timing:** You must complete your purchase within the 14-day window to secure the reduced price, as items revert to standard retail value immediately after the period ends [discounts].

**Summary for your purchase:**
*   If you buy **regular-priced** items, you can use your 10% student/military discount [discounts].
*   If you buy **clearance** items, you get the minimum 25% off, but you **cannot** use your 10% student/military discount on those items [discounts].
*   You cannot stack the 10% discount with the 25% clearance discount [discounts].

I hope this clarifies the rules for you. If you need further assistance or have questions about specific items, I can offer to escalate the ticket to a human agent.
